name: Explore the Grotto
author: Donatien Rabiller
description: A top-down adventure: explore the rooms of the grotto, avoid the bats and find the way forward, with hearts for health.

descriptions.en: A top-down adventure: explore the rooms of the grotto, avoid the bats and find the way forward, with hearts for health.
descriptions.it: Un'avventura vista dall'alto: esplora le stanze della grotta, evita i pipistrelli e trova la via per proseguire, con i cuori come salute.
